caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling an ornate candle snuffer or wick trimmer, rendered in shades of gold, yellow, and brown. The object includes a rectangular, box-like component positioned horizontally in the center, which has a slightly curved top and visible lines suggesting wood grain or metal texture. Attached to the left side is a circular pivot with a pointed, arrow-like extension, and a small rounded foot protrudes from the bottom. On the right side, the object features intricate, curving, and looping design elements that resemble handles or scissor grips, with two circular ends at the top and bottom. There is a domed, circular element near the center where the ornate handles meet the rectangular body. The background is a plain, creamy beige tone, and the object is centered and isolated with no additional items or features present in the image.
title: Candle Snuffer
